activities.description: Women open the tailgate of a GMC truck and begin loading camping gear.
Woman 1 lowers and raises the MultiPro tailgate step.
Women continue loading gear, including sleeping bags and lanterns.
Woman 2 plugs in a camping lantern to the 120v outlet inside the truck bed.
Woman 1 connects her phone to the truck's audio system while Woman 2 looks on.
The truck reverses out of the garage as the Everett dealership information is displayed on screen.
